title: Great for a small room or for concentrated heating
text: Great for a small room or for concentrated heating. I do love the Vornado styling, having owned several f these in the past few years.They look great in a room, sleek and modern, and smaller than they appear in the picture (I believe they are less than 20 inches in height). Problem with the Vornado is the space it can really heat. I wouldn't get this for a room any larger than 8 x 10 or so. Might be perfect for a kid's dorm room. Or you can use it, as I do, near my legs when I work at my desk. For close spaces it's a great tower heater.Just don't expect it to do away with a much lower thermostat setting in your house.

product_metadata.title: Vornado TH1 Whole Room Tower Heater,Black
features: HEAT DIFFERENTLY — With V-Flow heat circulation, uniquely contoured air outlets create a current of heat that is continuously moving throughout the room, creating quiet, comfortable whole room heat circulation without the need for oscillation.
HEAT SAFELY — Advanced safety features include a cool-touch exterior, tip-over protection, and automatic safety shut-off system for worry-free use.
HEAT EFFICIENTLY — Set your comfort with 3 quiet heat settings (Low/750W, Medium/1125, High/1500W) and a fan-only setting to tailor heat output and energy consumption.
CONTROL YOUR COMFORT — Adjustable thermostat allows you to select your desired comfort level.
SUPERIOR SUPPORT — Backed by a 5-year warranty and supported by a customer service team based in Andover, KS.
Built to meet U. S. voltage requirements. Certified, safety-tested, and warrantied for use only in the U. S.
description: The Vornado TH1 Tower Heater effectively circulates heat, without the need for oscillation, using V-Flow™ heat circulation. Whole room heat circulation begins with a powerful blower to create a strong current of hot air. By passing the heat through specially contoured louvers, the TH1 distributes the heated air in a wide, V-shaped pattern that creates a more consistently comfortable space. This wide, powerful airflow is superior to oscillating heaters that create unbalanced heat output and leave hot and cold spots in the room. The TH1 gives you simple control of the on-board thermostat to precisely dial in your comfort setting. Select from 3 fan settings, and select "Auto" mode to allow the fan to cycle on and off with the heating element, or "Continuous" for constant circulation with or without heat. The TH1 is equipped with a host of safety features, including a tipover switch, automatic safety shut off if airflow becomes obstructed, a sturdy, non-oscillating base, and an exterior that stays cool to the touch, even after hours of operation. Model is made for 120 volts only.

IMPORTANT INTERNATIONAL DISCLAIMER: This item is built to meet U.S. voltage requirements and may not function properly when used in conjunction with external devices that alter or convert voltage or frequency of electricity. Improper use or shipping the product outside the U.S. will void all warranties.
